## Singular

### NOMINATIVE

racht caoin

▪an racht caoin

### GENITIVE

rachta chaoin

▪an rachta chaoin

**NOTE** When the definite article
( _an_)
is not present, generally the nominative is used instead of the genitive:
_ag lorg an rachta chaoin, le haghaidh an rachta chaoin_
but _ag lorg racht caoin, le haghaidh racht caoin_.


## Plural

### NOMINATIVE

rachtanna caoine

▪na rachtanna caoine

### GENITIVE

rachtanna caoine

▪na rachtanna caoine
